content:
Let’s evaluate each option:  

**(A)** During contraction, H zones shorten, not elongate — so false.  

**(B)** In the relaxed state, tropomyosin blocks myosin’s binding sites on actin — this is true based on the sliding filament theory.  

**(C)** The myosin head (not helical tail) contains actin-binding and ATPase sites — so false.  

**(D)** Troponin and tropomyosin are regulatory proteins on thin filaments; they are not the thick and thin filaments themselves — false.  

Final answer: (B)
